body: You removed the destructors but forgot to null the singletons on finalization.

Usually it's 3D first, then 2D for init, right? I think you flipped it here.

(also side note; technically you'd expect to be initited / deinited as a stack, e.g. init 3D, then 2D, later deinit 2D, then 3D. Though it's probably inconsequential so we can consider it out of scope)

is it 3d first? I am not sure, it feels so random in places what goes first. for navigation the only reason 3d did go first was because there was no 2d equivalent for a long time so the 3d stuff had to exist first because 2d needed it.
yea because it was copied from the navserver manager that also does not do it there, kappame surprised.
It is pretty random what goes first, I'd be surprised if there was any reason to it other than it just happened this way. It would be nice to standardize but doesn't need to be today.
well if we want to keep going with a somehow alphabetical order like we do in most headers 2 < 3 so 2D should go before 3D anyway.
